description: Name under which the product is sold.
Class or type designation such as "Malt Beverage," "Stout," "Ale," "India Pale Ale," etc.; must be consistent with regulations or TTB guidance and separate and apart from other information.

mandatory_item_name: Other Designation (Distinctive or Fanciful Name with Statement of Composition)
description: A distinctive or fanciful name together with an adequate and truthful statement of the composition of the product.

mandatory_item_name: Name and Address (domestic, wholly fermented in US)
description: Bottler's name and city/state as listed on brewer's notice; may be on label or molded into container.
Net contents statement in U.S. customary units (fl oz, pints, quarts, gallons); metric may be added.
Alcohol by volume statement rules and tolerances; required in certain cases.
Alcohol by weight may be shown but must accompany % alcohol by volume.
Mandatory government health warning wording and formatting requirements.
Country of origin marking for imported malt beverages; CBP rules apply.
Importer name and city/state; must follow 'Imported by' or similar phrase.
If FD&C Yellow No. 5 is used, label must state that fact.
If cochineal extract or carmine is used, label must state that fact.
If total sulfur dioxide ≥ 10 ppm, label must state 'Contains Sulfites' (or equivalent).
If aspartame is used, label must include 'PHENYLKETONURICS: CONTAINS PHENYLALANINE' in caps and separate.
